newsitem.title: INDIA: Late buying drives Delhi shares to a steady close.
newsitem.headline: Late buying drives Delhi shares to a steady close.

text.p: Late buying by operators stemmed early losses as shares on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed marginally lower, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 0.59 points lower at 709.34.

"Marketmen feel that the credit policy to be announced on Saturday is expected to be capital market friendly, which influenced the trading sentiment to some extent," said Sunit Prabhakar of Spurt Securities.
The government is expected to announce the new credit policy on Saturday.
Reliance Industries gained 0.60 rupee at 195.85 and State Bank of India closed 7.55 rupees higher at 217.55.
TELCO rose 4.95 rupees to 422.35 while ACC lost 66.50 rupees at 1,573.50.
Larsen and Toubro was up 2.05 rupees to 213.05.
